[1/3] Replay archived run seeds from the terminal and Web career dossier

impact_assessment.why: The run archive stores seeds but offers no way to reuse them; players must copy a seed and start over manually.
impact_assessment.benefits: One explicit action revisits an interesting or daily seed, making the archive useful for practice and comparison.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new replay command/button only, no schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: replay replaces the live engine; state: a past daily key must not silently rewrite historical daily bests.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Replay as a normal run with the archived seed, ignore the archived daily key, require an explicit index or confirmation, and cover valid/invalid replay paths plus the existing reset API.

[1/3] Harden backup integrity and non-finite save/career metadata

impact_assessment.why: The crash-safe save claim depends on the shadow backup, but a corrupt primary can be copied over a good .bak before replacement; NaN/Infinity metadata can also crash archive rendering or career load.
impact_assessment.benefits: Recovery survives a corrupt primary, archives remain listable with damaged metadata, and malformed career numbers cannot take the dossier down.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: storage internals only, no save schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: single-user atomic writes; state: valid saves must behave exactly as before and career sanitization must keep good values.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate the primary before refreshing the backup, fall back to file mtime for unusable timestamps, reject non-finite daily values, and cover both corruption paths with failing-first tests.

[1/3] Track consecutive daily-run participation and show the streak in both dossiers

impact_assessment.why: Daily runs record a best gain per day but no streak, so returning players have no visible retention signal or long-term daily goal.
impact_assessment.benefits: A streak makes the daily challenge a habit loop, distinguishes same-day repeats from consecutive days, and adds a durable career stat without changing gameplay balance.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: career.json gains additive streak fields; dependency: none; concurrency: settlement remains one-shot; state: old careers default to zero and same-day repeats must not inflate the streak.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Resolve consecutive days by ISO date, treat same-day repeats as no-ops, reset on gaps, sanitize old values, and cover first/consecutive/same-day/gap paths in engine and CLI tests.

[1/3] Add a one-use Dead Man Switch shop item that banks half the unbanked loot on lockout

impact_assessment.why: Lockout currently wipes all unbanked loot with no mid-run mitigation; the push-your-luck loop has no costly insurance decision.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players can trade banked credits for a partial safety net, creating a real risk-pricing choice and a new use for the Black Market.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CyberDeck and shop catalog gain an additive field/item; dependency: none; concurrency: settlement remains one-shot; state: old saves default uninsured, and the consumable must not persist as a career upgrade.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default the deck flag to false, consume it only on a lockout payout, exclude consumables from career persistence, and cover purchase, lockout, persistence and old-save behavior with tests.
